value.Title: Influenza A(H5N1) - United States of America
value.Summary: Between 16 October and 4 November 2026, the United States of America, through its International Health Regulations (IHR) National Focal Point, notified WHO of three laboratory-confirmed human infections with influenza A(H5) virus in Washington State.
